checks: Direct Settings route opens the approved seven-category index with all 44 controls retained and one visible panel
Every category reveals its original fields without remounting inputs or writing to the journal
Unsaved profile fields, lb increment metadata and multiple exclusions survive category switching and an unrelated appearance save
Original profile and workout preference controllers save canonical values, retain category/disclosure and preserve all workout records
Vertical keyboard navigation uses roving focus, hidden fields cannot take focus and returning to Settings remembers the category
Seven categories fit eight widths in both themes, with no horizontal overflow, 44px targets or data writes from navigation
Reduced-height input hit geometry, backup/restore tools and safe app updates stay accessible through the existing controls
The integrated Settings layout reloads offline with the entire saved journal and preferences intact
scope: Actual integrated Settings B in Chromium with synthetic records, real form saves, keyboard focus, retained fields, viewport geometry and offline worker. Physical mobile keyboards/WebKit not certified.
